avis.texte: I used to use MAC exfoliant but since they discontinued years ago, I tried this one and never looked back.

I'm not one to leave a review on any product ever, to be honest. But this scrub honestly works wonders!! I've been dealing with closed comedone acne for years. I went to my dermatologist quite a few times. We were able to get it under control for a year or two with prescribed oral medication and prescribed face washes. However for me, I've come to the point where I want to avoid needing to ingest any type of medication or avoid needing to schedule yearly check ins just to pay more money for the actual prescription. I stopped taking the oral meds everyday and was holding steady with just the prescribed face wash, even though I wanted to find another solution to that too. I one day used hair oil to start focusing on my hair health, but it made my forehead break out and my closed comedones came back!!!! I was scrambling the last week trying to figure out how to clear my forehead, especially with a wedding next week that im a bridesmaid for. I researched online and came to find Differin. However it was my husband who also recommended Clinique to me, stating he used it all throughout college to help with his acne, especially to stay clear during sports. When I say it's been only a week of using both this scrub and Differin that my forehead is almost completely cleared!!!!! Idk if it's more one or the other, but I believe it's both working hand in hand. The scrub can def be a bit abrasive if using everyday and scrubbing as hard as I am, but that's easily fixed with light moisturize
I have oily, acne prone skin. I love this scrub. It effectively clears most of my pores. My skin feels great after using it. It's a savior for summer when I'm sweating a lot.
The grit level of this scrub is perfect. Not so coarse that it hurts and not so fine that you can barely feel it. It doesn't dissolve immediately so you get a super clean feeling.

I have used this scrub since my teenage years. It's my favorite for my sensitive skin. It will get the job done gently. No strong smell and easy to remove and clean off. This Clinique Classic is a wonderful product and i will continue to purchase as long as they make it.
I love this exfoliating scrub. It's the only exfoliating scrub that I use. It helps with the tea zone oiliness and gets my pores clean. I've been using it for over 25 years!

I've been using this for years. I use it about once a week, for general exfoliation. Makes the skin so smooth and even in texture. Not sure I'd recommend this to others, but I use it around the eyes with no problem or irritation. Just sayin.

I been using this product for years and I love it! It is effective when it comes to minimizing pores/texture on the face. This product also makes your skin feel smooth after exfoliating. To be honest any product by Clinique works great and this one of my favorite from the brand.

I've been loyal to this stuff since high school many moons ago. I flirted with other brands and types, but nothing compares to the roughness of this scrub. It's wonderful. I can actually feel the difference if I go more than a few days without it.

I love this scrub, first time trying it. My skin felt very soft and smooth after 1 use, I could see how fresh and clean it was. This is a great buy for anyone who's looking for a weekly facial, tough but gentle. I would definitely recommend it!! Thank you, thank you for creating a great product.

I have oily/combination skin. I mostly use the All About Clean Rinse-Off Foaming Cleanser and I use the Exfoliating Scrub about once a week. The 7-day scrub cream doesn't work for me at all, but the Exfoliating Scrub helps to clean off dry/dead skin and to brighten my complexion. I would be seriously lost without this product.
Helps my skin glow and sheds dead skin over time. Only scrub I will use. It's doesn't dry out my skin.

avis.titre: I'm a long time customer of this particular product
avis.texte: Clinique facial scrub is gentle on my skin and at the same time leaves my face feeling soft, clean and fresh.
I used to use a product from MAC until they discontinued it. Found this product online and it works great for me
I have used this exfoliating scrub for years. I will continue to use it.
Love this scrub. I use it 2-3 times per week and my face is so soft!
I have tried many exfoliations over the years and this one by Clinique is the BEST. Highly effective without being too abrasive. I love it.
Leaves skin feeling soft and rejuvenated! I've used this product for years. Highly recommend
This facial scrub leaves my skin feeling thoroughly cleansed but also moisturized. I definitely recommend.

I have used this product for a few years and I loved it until the most recent tube that I ordered in late April. I finished off my previous tube a few weeks ago, then went straight to April's tube. I was very disappointed to find that it seems to have much less of the actual silica than previous tubes, and thus doesn't exfoliate as well. Unless this is a blip, I will need to search outside Clinique for an equivalent product going forward, and if it is a blip, quality control is lacking. Unfortunately I'm not willing to spend the money on another tube to find out.

avis.titre: The BEST exfoliator for your face!
avis.texte: This is the best exfoliate for my face. It is gentle enough to use daily and leaves my face feeling very clean. I've tried a lot of exfoliants and I keep coming back to this one.
I'm 47 with combination skin. This scrub leaves my skin smooooth! I've had a salt facial & I feel similar smoothness from using this scrub. Just be careful not to over do it...

It felt amazing for 2 days ,but then I saw I was breaking out so I thought that I should continue to use well… it started to break me out and it felt greasy. And then it broke me out for two months I am still trying to get rid of them :( . I would say not to get ,but that would be me being petty because different products work for different people.

Over the years, this has been the BEST exfoliating scrub. Gone is the nice minty, tingling, clean feeling! Why? My friends & fam all loved after trying over the years, not so much now. Same as all the other brands now :(

I will still purchase this scrub, but I REALLY wish you had kept the menthol in it. I have been a faithful Clinique customer since my teens -- I am now 63. I have loved and used this scrub for decades and so appreciated the fresh menthol scent and the feeling it gave my skin. Please bring the menthol back -- or offer it with and without ...
strongest face exfoliating wash i could find, does as described and didnt cause a breakout
This product never disappoints! It does what it's supposed to every time. I have dry skin and can use it 5 times a week without any issues. I highly recommend.

I have tried many other brands and keep coming back to this one. I get regular facials, exfoliants, chemical peels, and other professional services, and this continues to be my go-to in between treatments. I even prefer this one over the 7 day scrub. It is gentle in that it doesn't create micro tears in my skin, but it's not too gentle in that you can't tell if it actually exfoliates your skin. I have been using this since I was in high school and I am currently in my mid 30s; I am constantly being complimented on my skin and told I don't seem to age. For those who miss the Menthol, a) there are other products on the market that contain Menthol b) there is a reason Clinique removed Menthol from this product. I know in the past, we learned to want fresh, squeaky clean skin, but some of those ingredients are not necessarily conducive to all skin types. What works for some may not work for others. I have combination skin and this had worked well for me, both the previous and current formulas.

I have Used Clinique since I was 15. I am Not 47. This product has been my favorite of all UNTIL the menthol was removed. I still love the scrub I cant Go without it but I sure do miss feeling the menthol on my face. It just made it feel so much cleaner and smoother!

I refuse to dock this product just because I can't use it anymore. In my 20s, I would no more miss a day using my beloved face scrub than I would have skipped brushing my teeth. My skin used to be thick and strong and oily in the T zone. Fast forward 30 years (because that's what it felt like!), and my skin can no longer handle physical scrubs, as it has become more thin and sensitive. I developed rosacea in my mid 30s (which I keep calm using Clinique's other skincare products) and I eventually started using retinoids. I realize that Clinique still sells chemical exfoliants in its Clarifying Lotions, and some of the serums contain actives, but it seems the focus is on BHA (salicylic acid) when I would love to see a dedicated AHA glycolic leave-on exfoliant. Meanwhile, this scrub was true love while it lasted, and it didn't seem to suffer in quality or effectiveness through its reformulation(s).

I have very oily, acne-prone skin. This exfoliator has been great. I really how you can feel the grit without it being too abrasive. This product doesn't dry me out or irritate my skin; in fact, my face feels so smooth after I use it! Definitely cleanses well and it may have even been helping with hormonal acne I have on my cheeks. I'm really glad I found this product.

I had perfectly clear skin with zero acne on my face. I only ever got a pimple or two when Im on my period. I washed my face with this product twice and now my cheeks are covered in cystic acne. My skin burns and is so irritated, I've stopped using the product and will be returning. This product ruined my face and I've been sobbing ever since. Do not use this product it is super rough on skin and will ruin it. I wish i could turn back time and never test this awful product. I wish i could give it zero stars.

I've been use the 3 step for a yr. I naturally have great skin thankfully, but wasn't aware of how important hydrated skin was. Anyways along with my anti wrinkle routine this product leaves the skin so fresh and super soft! So worth it!!!!

avis.titre: Comparable to St Ives Apricot Scrub
avis.texte: This is very abrasive and hard to get out of the tube. I'd compare it to St Ives Scrub. It's like sand paper on your face! I started using it on my body.
Clinique messed up what was a stellar product. Now, the tingly sensation—good—has been replaced by a burning, stripped-skin sensation—bad—after use. Will definitely be moving on from this one.

I wasn't expecting alot. Let me tell you I was definitely impressed. It worked so well after the first use. I had some dry patches on my cheek and this helped so much! my foundation looked amazing. I've used this 4 times already and my skin is so soft and no more dry patches. It isn't a hard scrub but you definitely feeling it working. If you need an exfoliate please consider this one.
I've tried many, and always come back to this one. Gentle, yet "scrubby" and abrasive enough. I use twice a week to clean the slate, and my face always feels smooth, clean and ready to go!
I also miss the menthol. I have been using this product for about 40 years and I always felt so refreshed after. Not any longer... PLEASE BRING THE MENTHOLD BACK.

i would not recommend buying this scrub at all if you have dry or sensitive skin as it is on the more abrasive side. i get a ton of build up, especially on my nose, and this product has left my face smooth and minimized the unsightly appearance of my blackheads. a little goes a very long way, and while it is on the pricey side, i highly recommend. it is a bit abrasive, so use sparingly, but overall, with the 2 years ive been using it, its the only exfoliator that has helped my oily skin.

I have used this and the men's face scrub for 30 years . So unhappy that the menthol has been removed. Also not happy that you're charging $1 more for the same product in the women's package for the same about as the men's package.

i bought this because I'd always thought you get what you pay for, considering how pricey this stuff is. i thought I was getting gold but with this product, along with the School Supplies trial kit, i couldn't have been more wrong. my face broke out like a teenager (I'm 36) and no more than a week after i went back to my original product (I Dew Care 💜) my face went back to normal. Don't do it! save your face! this product is not only not worth the price, it's not worth the struggle.

I had used this product for years. For no real reason I stopped using it as my exfoliating scrub and I just purchased a new tube and am really bummed out. Looks like they removed the menthol from the ingredients. Still a good product I just miss the refreshing clean feeling from before.

I'm using this product for the first time and I like it! Only a small amount is needed and with water it spreads quickly and evenly. And, it feels good on my skin; very little dryness after washing it off. I would purchase this product again.

WOW! Two full days of use and ALL my blackheads are gone. Exceeded my expectations! Best my skin has ever looked. I just turned 60 and after years of trying many brands, I had low expectations. I have used Clinique makeup off and on but never the washes or skincare products until very recently. This is my first purchase of the scrub. I had been using a popular dermatologist regimen of products but never got rid of persistent breakouts and blackheads.
This product is more pricey but is amazing. A little goes a long way, and using weekly as needed, I definitely saw results and felt a difference in my skin.
I get super patchy dry skin during winter months and this helps when my skin just needs a little polish. It's not to harsh.

avis.titre: The best there is, hands down
avis.texte: Granules are small, and in a paste-like non-greasy cleanser which makes it the perfect exfoliator for all skin types. I use it about twice a week, and it keeps my face soft.
This is a great scrub. Not very " gritty " or hates at all. Could actually use every day even Rinses well. Leaves my skin smooth yet not at all irritated
Wow, this scrub is the best I've ever tried. My skin feels so smooth and silky. Helps prevent ingrowns too!

I have been using Clinique's exfoliating scrub for over 20 years. The formula has changed a little, but not drastically. Because of the price I tried to find something else out there for less that did the same. I never found it. I soon came back to Clinique's scrub because it works the best. I have always has more oily skin so exfoliating has always been important. This does the job. It is more intense, so if you have delicate or sensitive skin, this may not be the solution for you. Or you could maybe just use it once in awhile. I feel the need to use it about every other day. I don't think they add any coloring to it or any fragrance. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean. And you don't need a lot so a tube does last awhile.

I've used this since I was a teenager, for 20+ years. Actually my whole family has used this for many years, Mom, sister and me at first, then years later my sister and I got our husbands into "the mint-scrub"! But the most recent bottle felt like a totally different product. I thought I got a bad batch, but I see the formula has been changed!! The menthol was so refreshing, it was the reason for buying this one... I also don't really care for the new texture either. I'm currently in the market for a new go-to scrub because after over 20 years of purchasing, I won't be buying this again.

avis.titre: What Happened To The Clean Refreshing Tingle
avis.texte: THis product is nothing like it used to be and in a smaller container. It has no refreshing feeling like it used to in the 1990 and 2000's. Its like dirt. I use baking soda now to get a really good scrub and follow up with a good soap. This product has become a disapointment. Sparkle skin is no good any mory either. No tingle. Try using sugar instead and maybe putting some menthol in it. Clinique is really short changing us on the scrubs. The soaps are still great and the lotions are awesome.But This.....

avis.titre: Not the same but still ok
avis.texte: I thought it was me at first that maybe got a weird tube or that I ordered the 7 day scrub rather than the exfoliator. But I do miss the original formula because of the totally clean feeling I would get with it.
I wasn't very impressed with this face wash. It felt like it was getting my face clean, but I didn't particularly care for the smell.
This is my second purchase of this product, it works great with my skin. My husband even uses it, so we'll have to buy him his own!

Like other reviews have said this new formulation is just not the same as the original release. I have tried my husband's Jack Black face scrub and that has the cooling effect and great exfoliation in case anyone would like to try it.

avis.titre: There's nothing like it out there
avis.texte: I have been using this product since the early 90s and it never disappoints! If you leave it on for a little bit, your skin will tingle. It has just the right amount of exfoliant. It really is awesome. I use it once a week.
This happens to be my favorite face scrub. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't give me any issues

I have been using this for years. It is gentle, but not too gentle. I have tried others specifically for your face, but they have been too gentle. Didn't feel like those did anything. This product works well and makes my face feel extra clean. I use just a couple times/week. Packaging is fine for me. First use is a tougher squeeze, but easy after that!!

avis.titre: Not the same, but still pretty great!
avis.texte: I've been using Clinique products for more than thirty years, and agree with other recent reviewers that it's not the same as it used to be, but honestly it's still great. I use it 1 to 2 times per week and it really makes a difference in the texture of my aging skin, it's less dull and my pores aren't as noticeable as when I get lazy and don't use it.

I agree with the other reviewers...bring back the original formula. This used to be the very best exfoliator on the market. Even as a broke teenager 30 years ago, I would splurge on this. Does anybody remember the St Ives apricot scrub? That was the cheap version when you couldn't afford Clinique - but it had large granules like sandpaper on your face!. Cliniques's tiny granules were perfect and did such a good job! Bring it back!

I LOVED this product for so many year and recently bought a new tube and the formula has changed :( it doesn't not exfoliate and it doesn't have the refreshing feeling like it used to. So sad and now in the search for a new exfoliating cream! Bring back please!!!!!

avis.titre: I have been purchasing for this scrub years
avis.texte: I use in the shower, where it is easy on, easy off. Do not rub your skin to hard, just a soft and gentle rub. Your face will feel very soft after the procedure.

Exfoliating Scrub is part of my daily cleansing routine and absolutely necessary for my super oily, acne prone skin. I've been using it for at least a decade. I recently got a new bottle and it is not the same! It is more like the 7 Day Scrub now. It is creamier and has less scrub in it and my skin is NOT liking it. The original formula was perfect. Why mess with a good thing??

I jut got it 2 days ago and so far love it. My skin was like sandpaper but feels nice and soft after using it. I have rosacea and this is very gentle for my skin yet exfoliates very well. Also, it seems as this tube will last forever, it's a paste consistency, very efficient.

avis.titre: The Old Formula Was SO MUCH BETTER!!!
avis.texte: This is okay. It's still does a better job than the 7day Scrub. BUT the old formula that I have been using for over 20 years was sooooo much better!!! Please bring it back by popular demand as I see many other reviews stating the same thing. I will say I do not like how the new formula smells. I literally have to hold my breath. I do not understand why Clinique would change it and remove the menthol. It's really a shame.

I'm new to this product so I'm just comparing it to the 7 day cream scrub and this is so much better. The other one was very weak and a bit greasy. I like to use this one with a bit of the rinse off foaming cleanser and WOW! Then ANR from EL and your regular moisturizer and wake up with the best skin of your life.

I wish I would have read the reviews to realize they changed their formula. I used to love their old exfoliation scrub it would make my skin feel smooth and rejuvenated. Now I might as well just get he 7 day rinse. I had been searching for something comparable and finally broke down and spent the money on this only to be left disappointed.

I used to use this several times a week. I stopped it temporarily when I was on chemo. as my skin got very dry. When I bought some new ones, they were very different to the old product. It no longer will scrub enough make any different to my oily skin, but also you no longer can remove the top of the tube, so you can't get air into the tube to get to the bottom of the tube. Please bring back your older product, and the old tube!

avis.titre: Honestly I have yet to find Any even comparable!❤️
avis.texte: I LOVE this product! I have gone through so many trying to find one similar, and NONE come close! Has the PERFECT amount of little gritty scrubbies for deep clean feeling. Could dry out your skin if used too often or you don't naturally have oily skin, or without a moisturizer. The only downside I can say is that Clinique products are only sold at select stores, and a little on the expensive side. But after using it, It's worth the $. Everyone has certain things they love and can't be substituted, this is one of those items for me. I have BAD breakouts more as an adult than ALL of my teen years combined, I think due to hormone levels.. if you're wanting a good facial scrub with the nitty-grittys like soft sandpaper ;) ..it gently removes that layer of yuck you don't want and leaves your skin soft, smooth, and CLEAN.❤️❤️❤️

How could you take something so perfect and change it to the point where you are alienating loyal consumers who have been swearing by this product for years....decades. Why would you change the formula so drastically to remove the one ingredient (menthol) that set it apart from anything else on the market? Why? Here are the cosmetic benefits of menthol: Antibacterial, Invigorating, Soothing, Cooling, Circulation-Stimulating, Plumping* I will no longer be purchasing this new, non-mentholated and oilier version that someone has decided to completely mess up. Thank you for d/c yet another holy grail item and forcing your customers to find alternatives.
This product makes my skin feel so clean, I love it so much. I will buy again

I was a little nervous after seeing some of the reviews of the new formula, but I'm happy to say this is still an excellent scrub. It's a strong scrub, so not one to use if you have rather delicate skin. Unfortunately, my skin is oily and acne prone and has large pores, so I need a substantial scrub, and this one meets my needs. I can absolutely tell the difference in the texture of my skin if I go too long without it! As a side note-- if you are like me and had to give up your grocery store scrub because you or someone in your house has been diagnosed with a tree nut allergy, this is a great solution. I was having a hard time finding a scrub that exfoliated as well as the ones with walnut shell powder, but this one absolutely does the trick, and now I don't have to worry that my face scrub is going to make my daughter go into anaphylaxis.
I love this and the every day exfoliator. I swap in between, where I use this one 2-3 times a week due to its coarseness. It makes my skin feel clean after.

avis.titre: Gives me a fresh, polished, glowing look!!
avis.texte: I forgot that I had this product, and when I started to use it again, was amazed at how my skin looked and felt. I wanted to purchase it again, however, after reading some of the latest reviews about the formula being changed, I'm having second thoughts. I agree with the other customers, if something has changed bring back the old formula. Thanks!

avis.titre: they can add more silica to make it more gritty. duh.
avis.texte: i used to love this scrub like the rest of the reveiws on here. i used to use avons clearskin invigorating scrub which was a dupe of this until all these companies reformulated cuz of plastic beads "ruining" oceans from cry babies from portlandia. so when avon discontinued i went back to this and then this sucked also. i use a different brand now with lots of silica beads. however silica and natural exfoliants are more damaging and abrasive to skin. also why are these products ending up in our lake and oceans anyway and why wasnt this brought up years ago.

I know you might not think packaging is a big deal, but for this product it is. This scrub is a dry clay type texture and you have to squeeze and squeeze just to get a little bit out. The tube ends up in a twisted knot. The product itself cleans well enough but I'm so tired of fighting to get it out of the tube.

I got a sample of this a few years ago. I remembered loving it, but never bought a bottle afterwards. I got my bottle in yesterday and I cant believe I waited so long to get some. I've used it twice now and have seen immediate improvement in the look and feel of my skin. I cant wait til tonight to use it again
I used to steal this from my mom growing up and it works so well. It isn't as abrasive as it once was before, so I think it will work for sensitive skin since mine is too. It smooths out my skin too.

I've used the exfoliating scrub for many years and was so disappointed when the "scrub factor" seemed so much weaker. I have been mixing the exfoliating scrub and the men's scrub together to try to create the "old feel". This is soooo disappointing. please bring back the old formula.

I totally agree with many other reviewers here.... why did you change this? I have used this product for years, and completely loved it. It was the perfect combination of the very best scrubbing granules, and the menthol fragrance. I looked forward to using it in the morning to 'wake me up' and it rinsed off beautifully. Never felt a residue, and never felt dry.... just felt clean and exfoliated. I tried the new formula, hoping the reviews were wrong. They were not. Why would you do this? I think you should give us your reasoning, so we can understand. I will not be purchasing the new formula again.
Did you remove the plastic particles that used to do the scrubbing? That would explain the changed feeling. Thank you for reducing plastic in our oceans!

avis.titre: BRING BACK THE OLD MENTHOL FORMULA
avis.texte: I have used Clinique products since 1982 and I understand products come and go, but I am so upset that you've changed the formula for this Exfoliating Scrub! This used to be a miracle product that had a high concentration of exfoliating particles in an easily rinseable, NON-GREASY mentholated cream base. That's right, folks, it actually helped wake me up and clear my sinuses, too! The new formulation is stiffer, doesn't rinse as easily, has fewer but more abrasive particles, and smells "old".
I love that this exfoliator is also creamy. While I wish there was a *bit* more grit to it, it is very gentle the way it is, and I am comfortable using it everyday. I never want to be without it!
I used to love this product and would use it all the time. I loved the menthol and the feeling you would get after using it. It is not the same. Bring back the original perfect product.
This is a great way to exfoliate as you do your daily beauty regime
This works good but definitely not worth the steep price! Drugstore products will probably do the same thing or better.

I bought an extra one because I LOVE IT! But there is no fresh feeling to it anymore… did formula change? I hate it and I though it was my face until I saw the reviews! I'm so upset and don't use it anymore. My face doesn't feel fresh like with my old one and it became like any other scrub. I'm so disappointed. It was my perfect morning scrub! My face would feel so refreshed and awake. Looked forward to it every morning. So upsetting!
I have used 7 Day cleanser for about 30 years. I have tried other products and always come back to Clinique.
Loved this scrub but formula changed from small and gritty to large beads which dont work as well and are almost irritating to my skin. disappointed in this change

This is by far the best face scrub I have ever used. If you are looking for that, a face scrub, this is what you need. This is not a cream, with a few exfoliates in it, but an actual scrub. Gentle but yet works great!!!
I've been spending hundreds trying to find the perfect blackhead remover and pore refining exfoliator, and I finally found it! I love it 10000/10 recommend using it

Have been happily using this products over the years & valued the light menthol smell & grainy feel that polished my skin & really refreshed. However the recent changes to the product has resulted in an odd chemical smell, menthol gone, scrub grains are too fine & leaves a oil based film on my face. Very disappointed & will not be purchasing again. Other "scrubs" by Clinique are not intended for Oily, strong skin types - PLEASE bring back former recipe!

avis.titre: Perfect product ruined, why Cinque why???
avis.texte: As many have others have shared here, Cinque has ruined a really lovely product. Using the original, minty version of this scrub was one thing I could always look forward to brightening my mood after a long day (and year...) Please Cinque, fix this for all your loyal and unhappy exfoliating scrub customers!!

I've used this scrub for 15 years. There is nothing I've tried that exfoliates so well and doesn't leave a greasy residue except this one! Exfoliating scrub is perfection and I'll never be without it. A must for oilier skin!

avis.titre: This has been my "go to" exfoliant for over 20 years
avis.texte: Use it like a face wash. Be careful of eye area. Wish it came in bigger size and easier package to use.
I loved the small travel sample, I had to purchase the full size. Doesn't leave the cool refreshing feeling afterwards but leaves face feeling clean, soft, and rejuvenated
I love how it is so gentle and smooths away any dead skin sapping away my youthfulness

avis.titre: Has my favorite scrub been reformulated?
avis.texte: I recently ordered my favorite scrub, except his is not my favorite scrub! The grains feel different, the menthol is gone and my face just doesn't feel as smooth afterwards. Please CLINIQUE, bring back my scrub!!!

Where's the menthol? I had been using the exfoliating scrub for over 20 years with MENTHOL! It was a daily relaxation treatment for me and my senses. Now it's just like rubbing clay on my face. Please bring back the old formula.

avis.titre: Please bring back the original formulation!
avis.texte: This is not the same products as I used for years! I am so disappointed in this new formulation. Gone is the tingly menthol that actually made me feel awake in the morning. Please pass the word onto the powers that be: If it ain't broke, don't fix it.

I thought maybe it was just me, but after reading some of the other reviews I know I am not the only one who thinks this product is different. I am definitely disappointed with my most recent purchase. As a religious Clinique user of more than 20+ years, I really hate it when formulas are changed on great products.
As others have noted...it now just terrible. Gravely, greasy and gross!!! Please bring back the old formulation! I've used this product for nearly 30 years.

WARNING: I just opened my new tube of my favorite scrub and found that the FORMULA HAS CHANGED. There are big beads now that are very harsh and probably pollute the oceans. Plus it is now even harder to squeeze out of the tube than ever before.

avis.titre: This product was my holy grain now it's trash
avis.texte: They last couple tubes I had barely squeezed out of the tube, but they were still minty. The newest tube I bought smelled like rancid oil broke me out and had no menthol. So I exchanged it thinking it was just an old tube. Nope same disgusting rancid crayon type smell, unsqueezable, and barely scrubs. So I thought I'd order from Clinique directly and see every one else's reviews. Why on earth would you change a perfect product? I'll return the new tube and look for something else I guess, but I will ALWAYS miss this product. It was a perfect match for my skin and gave me the best results while being enjoyable to use.
